capabilities.name: SENSE-001
capabilities.summary: Turn recorded plans into bounded sense frames and mutation candidates.
capabilities.gate: Choose local inputs and separately authorize any consequence.

capabilities.name: ARROW-001
capabilities.summary: Track exact transitions and predecessor receipts between states.
capabilities.gate: Witnessed arrows are not permission or media regeneration.

capabilities.name: CANON FIELD 001
capabilities.summary: Verify signed, owner-scoped selections of exact Git commits without treating main as canon.
capabilities.gate: External owner trust pins and deliberate selection; no automatic execution.

capabilities.name: Conversation Collider 003
capabilities.summary: Read actual Git-pinned interface declarations and propose bounded cross-project work.
capabilities.gate: Actual files, equipment presence, rights and receiver authority remain unchecked.
